name: Love In Marriage
overview: Scripture reveals that marriage is a divine gift, with Proverbs highlighting the blessing and favor that comes from finding a wife. Ephesians instructs wives to submit to their husbands as they would to the Lord, emphasizing a God-ordained order within marriage. Husbands are called to love their wives sacrificially, modeling Christ’s love for the church, demonstrating selflessness and devotion as the foundation of marital love.
